notes: Generated as a template: not verified on a device or against the English web editor.
The public recipe API answers Accept-Language en-US (1015 MC Smart recipes on 2026-10-13); en-GB is refused.

Complexity ids and the editor path come from SmartRecipe (src/catalogs/catalogs.ts, src/mc/urls.ts) and are unverified; only the de-DE path was checked. The default group name is a translation of the German editor's name.

Ingredient catalog, piece weights and the corpus tables are generated from the en-US corpus; vocabulary, phrases, technique wording and prompt rules are written by hand from its most frequent spellings and text steps.
